lexical_metric_definitions.consecutive_word_repeat: Any adjacent identical word tokens w[i] == w[i+1].
lexical_metric_definitions.close_content_repeat: Any non-stopword repeated within distance <= 2 tokens (e.g. 'white and white', 'hat and hat').
lexical_metric_definitions.repeated_content_bigram: Any 2-gram containing at least one non-stopword occurring >= 2 times in the same caption.
lexical_metric_definitions.any_lexical_repetition: Union of consecutive_word_repeat, close_content_repeat, and repeated_content_bigram.
lexical_metric_definitions.truncated_ending: Caption ending in a dangling determiner/preposition/auxiliary/conjunction, excluding valid phrasal endings like 'looks on' or 'stands by'.
lexical_metric_definitions.static_the_x_is: Matches '^the \w+(?:\s+\w+)? is \w+$' (e.g. 'the snow is white', 'the dog is brown').
